decisions.reason: The same-message INTRODUCE already records that the FAQ must explain Winners-page announcement and one-click prize claiming, so no additional or edited Event is required.
Changing where and how winners claim prizes does not change the Chainlink VRF selection method, eligibility, weighting, or verification rules.
The one-click Winners-page claim flow does not change Big Block prize amounts, winner count, funding, or draw triggers.
The one-click Winners-page claim flow does not change Small Block prize amounts, winner count, funding, or draw conditions.
Prize collection occurs after winner selection and does not change ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, or post-draw resets.
The prize-claim interaction and location do not alter secondary-sale royalty amounts, enforcement, allocation, or ticket behavior.
The prize-claim flow does not change mint price, founder allocation, referral commission, or prize-pool destinations.
Locating one-click prize claims on the Winners page does not change which referral, ticket, or badge attributes appear in NFT metadata.
The prize-winner collection flow does not modify badge milestones, storage, icon rules, approved badges, or current badge effects.
Using the Winners page for prize claims does not resume or otherwise change the deferred Discord community-server requirement.
The prize-claim interaction and location do not change the Transak provider, supported payment methods, conversion behavior, or wallet requirements.
The winner claim flow does not change how a no-referral mint selects an existing NFT holder or allocates its random reward.
